title: Remove a CA certificate from trusted settings
summary: Remove a Certificate Authority (CA) certificate from your user's trust settings. Your Mac will no longer trust certificates signed by this CA.

steps.explain: Remove a CA certificate from the per-user Trust Settings.

placeholders.name: CA_CERT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the CA certificate file to remove.

rollback.explain: Re-add the CA certificate to the per-user Trust Settings.

placeholders.name: USER_KEYCHAIN
placeholders.description: The path to the user's keychain database.

placeholders.name: CA_CERT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the CA certificate file.

warnings: Removing a trusted certificate may cause applications or websites that rely on it to stop working.
